show.description: Ambitious CEO Elina Sen strikes a dangerous deal—to tame reckless heir Ranveer Khanna in exchange for power. But beneath boardroom battles and fiery attraction lies her hidden agenda: revenge against his brother Vikram, the man who destroyed her past. As love, manipulation, and betrayal collide, Elina risks losing everything—including her heart to the love-child with a heart of gold Ranveer. Watch Now
